name: Sawada Maaya
source:
She is the driving school's mechanic. Although she is young, her skill is certain, and she is in charge of maintaining the training cars. The oily work clothes and glasses look bad.
She is more interested in men than anyone else, but she is a shy type who can't take drastic actions.

[From Getchu]
